non-blocking: no case exercises the no-record branch's withholding: tests/test_a_held_request_is_drawn_by_its_owner.py asserts the owner table and the two written-hold populations only, and main's tests/test_a_request_that_has_not_launched_is_not_drawn_working.py asserts the state word alone, so deleting `next_action = None` here leaves every suite green while a held pointer with no written record hands the classifier's release again.

non-blocking: the declared mutation's "9 failed, 2 passed" has no log in logs/, and the mutation as described (hold_owner returning the coordinator's reading for every hold) reaches only the six parked cases and the owner table, since the two launched-run cases never call hold_owner through the written-record gate at recovery_watch.py:1400, so at most 7 of 11 cases could fail and the recorded figure does not reconcile with the test file it describes.

non-blocking: the fragment states 104 test files at the merged head, while logs/importers-head.log's header names 105 files against logs/importers-main-tip.log's 104, so the population the two arms compare is not the one the record states.
